name: Weekly Recap
tagline: Turns a week of bot runs, commits and calendar entries into one progress report
description: At the end of each week it pulls together what actually happened - automated runs, repo commits, calendar entries, routines and your own notes - and shapes it into one written recap you can actually use. It only reads; nothing is posted anywhere without your say-so.
author: Christian_O91
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
